facts.text: I cooked for important people once, Lars, and the mouse still got to the cheese plate before us. Eat what is left.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Ernie's words, but he never says it. Ernie did cook for the mayor once, and a cockroach in a cigar box ended that night. I could not open a quote page for this pass (the search tool was out of budget), so there is no quote source.
facts.fix: I cooked for the mayor once, Lars, and look how that went. Eat before the mouse gets to it.
